title: Three reports link to a particular checkout and a nonexistent Java filename ending in :line
reproduction: Resolve the Markdown link destinations in the archived editor patch, Home patch and VPN reviews at 783be5650. Treat the URL path literally as a repository renderer does.
expected: Open the referenced source file from any checkout; leave historical line coordinates and the original finding/status unchanged.
observed: 19 destinations (1 editor, 8 Home, 10 VPN) use /Users/steves/.../AdAway/...java:N. None is a file at that path including the :N; a different checkout cannot rely on the absolute prefix either.
fix: Replace only those destinations with paths relative to the report. Open the file, not a current-line anchor that could imply the old finding still applies at that line. Preserve displayed text, snapshot hashes and historical line numbers.
test_evidence: All 19 replacement destinations resolve to the same exact-case tracked Java paths after stripping the original checkout prefix and :N. Non-link bytes of all three reports compared with the intake version. No Java edits or tests.

title: Tooling handoff identifies the wrong file for its 36 assessments
reproduction: Read the 36-file coverage statement in tooling-audit-review.md and compare its filename with the local manifest and scoped receipt.
expected: Point to tooling-audit-files.csv, the bounded handoff containing exactly those assessments.
observed: The report said Files.csv. No exact-case tracked file has that name in the directory; its case-insensitive namesake files.csv is the canonical 2,914-row intake inventory, not the 36-row handoff.
fix: Link the scoped receipt by its exact relative filename. No coverage or status claims changed.
test_evidence: Parsed 36 data rows and 36 distinct paths in tooling-audit-files.csv. Verified the link target from the report directory and compared all other bytes with intake.
